messages:
Mike (Support): urgent escalation — onboarding sync failing for several trial accounts, customers stuck at 'team activation'. seeing 502 from /api/v1/onboard/sync. stack trace attached. can't progress invites.
Elaine (CSM): ack. which customers are blocked? renewals affected?
Mike (Support): NovaHealth (45 seats, renewal 2026-07-10), Hearthly (12 seats, renewal 2026-05-02), PetraAI (5 seats, trial ending 4/5).
Raj (SE): repro steps? I can try a hotfix or safe rollback.
Mike (Support): repro: POST /api/v1/onboard/sync -> 502, logs show "KVCacheMiss -> null pointer". quick snippet: ```ERROR onboard/sync: kv_cache.go:132: nil pointer deref```
Raj (SE): ok seeing possible NPE in kv cache purge path after a recent kv eviction change. tagging eng-oncall. @eng-oncall-bot can you take a look and spin a canary? :eyes:
eng-oncall-bot: INCIDENT INC-2025-347 created, priority=P1, assigned to @raj_se. Runbook: onboard-sync-npe.
Sara (CS Ops): thanks. CS comms plan: 1) Proactive note to NovaHealth + Hearthly within 1h, 2) offer immediate manual invite workaround (CS will send), 3) update status page and set expectation 2-4h for full fix. Who owns customer comms?
Elaine (CSM): I will draft messages and send to NovaHealth now. PetraAI in trial — I'll personally call and offer manual invite; low seats but high risk.
Raj (SE): short-term workaround: run `POST /internal/v1/invite/regenerate {team_id}` for impacted teams. I can grant Mike a temporary token to run this until we patch.
Mike (Support): please grant token, i'll run it and confirm. also can you drop exact endpoints to run?
Raj (SE): command: ```curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer TEMP-REGEN-TOKEN' https://api.redwood.ai/internal/v1/invite/regenerate -d '{"team_id":"<team>"}'``` do not use prod token in logs.
Elaine (CSM): draft message for NovaHealth: "We're aware of an onboarding issue causing invite failures. Our engineers are working on a fix; as a temporary measure we can regenerate your invites manually. ETA initial mitigation within 2 hours. Apologies for the interruption — Elaine, CSM." I'll post after Raj confirms workaround.
Sara (CS Ops): timeline and owners: Raj - triage/patch (P1), Mike - execute regen for listed accounts, Elaine - customer comms + call PetraAI, Sara - status page + exec update. Check-in cadence 30m.
Mike (Support): running regen for NovaHealth now. will report back when invites accepted.
Raj (SE): I pushed a rollback to kv-eviction change to canary, monitoring. will promote if stable.
eng-oncall-bot: Canary deploy started, watch logs for 10m.
Mike (Support): NovaHealth invites regenerated and accepted by admin. Hearthly regen queued.
Elaine (CSM): I sent the proactive note to NovaHealth and Hearthly, included temporary workaround and contact number. PetraAI call scheduled in 10m.
Sara (CS Ops): updating status page: "Investigating onboarding invite failures, temporary manual invite offered, engineers working on patch. Updates every 30m." posted.
Raj (SE): canary stable for 15m, promoting to wider rollout. will monitor token usage and error rates.
Mike (Support): Hearthly invites completed, PetraAI manual invite accepted during call. all three accounts active again.
Elaine (CSM): great — I'll follow up with renewal playbook for NovaHealth (high seat). recommend 1:1 with CSM + credits offer for disruption.
Sara (CS Ops): closing comms loop: file incident summary and postmortem owner? Raj can you own postmortem, Elaine will own customer follow-ups, Mike will collect logs for timeline.
Raj (SE): I'll own the postmortem. initial notes in INC-2025-347.
eng-oncall-bot: INCIDENT INC-2025-347 status -> resolved, resolved_by=@raj_se, resolution_summary="rollback + regen workaround".
Elaine (CSM): thanks team. will update account health dashboard and flag NovaHealth for renewal outreach. :white_check_mark:
Mike (Support): thanks — closing thread when postmortem link is posted.
Sara (CS Ops): filed comms record in CS tracker: https://redwood.internal/cs/tracker/INC-2025-347. closing in 2h after postmortem link.
